page: UpCloud GPU-20xCPU-256GB-1xL4 is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for workloads requiring dedicated graphics acceleration and substantial system memory. Built on the x86_64 CPU architecture, this instance features 20 shared vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 12.8 GB per vCPU. The virtualized environment is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

The server includes a single NVIDIA L4 GPU from the Ada Lovelace family, equipped with 24 GB of VRAM. This hardware configuration does not include any local storage, meaning storage resources must be attached externally. Additionally, the instance is provisioned with one complimentary public IPv4 address.

A key architectural consideration is the shared CPU allocation, which may introduce resource contention compared to dedicated CPU instances. However, the high memory capacity and dedicated GPU make this configuration suitable for memory-intensive GPU workloads, such as machine learning inference, data science jobs, and graphics rendering pipelines that do not require high-performance local storage.
